title: Overhead Reroute Contribution for Repeat-Break Interior Lines, Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Overhead Reroute Contribution for Repeat-Break Interior Lines

Field operations note, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, interior supply and drain lines.

## Rule

An interior line calls for whole-line work when the plan replaces whole lines after repeat breaks, which is when its full replacement break count is above zero, and the most recent completed repair on the same line was completed no more than the plan's replacement lookback days before the request date. An interior line that keeps breaking beneath the slab is rerouted overhead, and Bridgewell contributes toward the reroute because it ends repeat slab openings. Interior reroute contribution: on an interior line that calls for whole-line work, a request on an interior drain line adds the drain reroute contribution and a request on an interior supply line adds the supply reroute contribution; every other request adds no reroute contribution. The interior reroute contribution is paid on top of the occurrence cap, and only for permanent interior work whose contractor quote is above the interior permanent-work payment.

## Plan figures that decide whole-line work

| Plan covering interior lines | Full-replacement break count | Replacement lookback |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | 0 (the plan does not replace whole lines after repeat breaks) | 0 days |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | 2 | 730 days |

## Contributions

| Calls for whole-line work | Line on the request | Interior reroute contribution |
|---|---|---|
| yes | interior drain line | $600.00 (drain reroute contribution) |
| yes | interior supply line | $400.00 (supply reroute contribution) |
| no | either | none |

## Boundary cases (Total Home Lines Plan)

- Most recent completed repair on the same line completed 730 days before the request date: the line calls for whole-line work. Completed 731 days before: it does not.
- No completed repair on the same line on record: the line does not call for whole-line work.
- On the Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan the break count is 0, so no interior line calls for whole-line work and no reroute contribution is added.

## Hypothetical example

Total Home Lines Plan; interior drain line; last completed repair on that line 200 days before the request date: $600.00 is added.
